easy.example: Take a deep breath and stay calm.

more.def: Peaceful and quiet; not excited, worried, or angry.
more.example: The lake was calm and smooth after the storm passed.

easy.def: Colors that help an animal hide.
easy.example: The frog's green skin is camouflage in the grass.

more.def: Colors or patterns that help an animal or thing blend in with what is around it.
more.example: A snowshoe hare's white fur is good camouflage in winter.

easy.example: The net will capture the fish.

more.def: To catch and hold a person, animal, or thing.
more.example: The photographer captured a picture of the eagle in flight.

easy.def: Trying hard to stay safe and not make a mistake.
easy.example: Be careful with the hot soup.

more.def: Paying close attention so that you avoid danger or mistakes.
more.example: She was careful not to step on the wet paint.

easy.def: To do something fun for a special day.
easy.example: We celebrate my birthday with cake.

more.def: To do something special or fun to mark a happy day or event.
more.example: The team celebrated their win with a pizza party.

easy.example: The big puzzle is a challenge.

more.def: Something difficult that tests your skill or strength.
more.example: Climbing the steep hill was a real challenge.

more.def: Happy and full of good feelings.
more.example: The cheerful bus driver greeted every child by name.

easy.def: What the weather is like in a place most of the time.
easy.example: The climate here is hot and dry.

more.def: The usual weather a place has over a long period of time.
more.example: Penguins live in a very cold climate.

more.def: To gather things together, sometimes as a hobby.
more.example: He collects stamps from countries all around the world.

more.def: Feeling relaxed and at ease, or making you feel that way.
more.example: These shoes are comfortable enough to wear all day.

easy.def: The people who live in one place.
easy.example: Our community has a park and a school.

more.def: A group of people who live in the same area or who share something important.
more.example: The whole community helped clean up the beach.

easy.def: To look at two things to see how they are the same or not the same.
easy.example: Compare the two apples. Which is bigger?

more.def: To look closely at two or more things to find how they are alike and different.
more.example: We compared the two maps and noticed that one had more rivers.

easy.example: It takes courage to try new things.

more.def: The strength to do something even though it is scary or hard.
more.example: It took courage to tell the truth about what happened.

easy.example: Let's create a picture with paint.

more.def: To make or invent something that did not exist before.
more.example: The students created a model of the solar system.

easy.example: A tiny creature ran under the leaf.

more.def: Any living animal, real or imaginary.
more.example: Strange creatures live at the bottom of the ocean.

easy.example: The curious kitten looked in the box.

more.def: Eager to learn or find out about something.
more.example: He was curious about how airplanes stay up in the sky.
